title: A Pathway-Driven Computational Drug Discovery Framework Integrating Machine Learning and Virtual Screening for Identification of Anti-Rheumatoid Arthritis Natural Small Molecules.
summary: A pathway-guided ML workflow selects natural-molecule candidates for rheumatoid arthritis and tests prioritized compounds in an in-vitro inflammatory model after docking and molecular-dynamics analyses; the evidence supports those assay results, not therapeutic efficacy.
ai_technology: Pathway-guided machine learning ranks rheumatoid-arthritis target candidates and natural molecules; docking and molecular-dynamics analyses prioritize compounds for cellular testing.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Machine-learning ranking and virtual screening selected compounds; the paper reports reduced IL6/MMP3 in TNFα-stimulated MH7A cells after SM1 treatment. These in-vitro findings do not establish therapeutic efficacy.
